image_description: A close-up shot of a light blue, textured fabric bib worn by a baby. The bib features a rounded neck opening and a curved bottom edge with visible stitching (possibly blanket stitch) along the perimeter. There is an embroidered design in the center featuring three small pink figures (possibly pigs or bears) and text below them that appears to read 'Bianca' or similar, though the letters are distorted. A brownish stain or shadow is visible on the lower right side of the bib. The background shows a blurred indoor setting with a window and furniture.
